protocol.noise_policy: R5C.2 frozen stream; seed shared across paired conditions and scales; never copy RAW residuals
protocol.rx_out_support: Independent signed branch factors magnitude 1%-3%, R and X paired, fixed before t0, physically consistent equilibrium
protocol.rx_bank: Five fixed R/X hypotheses: nominal, global +/-2%, selected-branch +/-3% paired R/X; condition tracks the simulation operating point, not an expanded model bank.
protocol.sources: Nine load buses and nine line candidates; known catalog, not unseen-source validation.
protocol.warmup_and_context: 10-s startup context fit and 12-s warmup (360 reports) before monitoring; earliest scheduled event begins at 16 s.

derived_channels.channels: 8 voltage magnitudes, 8 voltage angles, 8 current magnitudes, 7 current angles, 8 bus frequencies and 8 ROCOF values; BUS39 current angle omitted.
derived_channels.frequency: 60 Hz plus derivative of reported voltage angle divided by 360; not rotor speed.
derived_channels.rocof: Second derivative from causal 21-report quadratic phase estimate; generator uses robust magnitude weights while predictor uses fixed unweighted fit.
derived_channels.measurement_noise: Noise is added to derived/report coordinates under the frozen R5C.2 noise stream at standard-deviation multipliers 1 and 2; cross-signal covariance field is not applied in the executed C01 operator.
